verdict.rationale: Adyen documents ordering terminals from its Customer Area dashboard. Docs-11 frames the API as an alternative to ordering there. It also offers a standalone terminal as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments' and Tap to Pay with no extra hardware. Nothing in the evidence covers self-serve sign-up, the approval/onboarding process or its timing, or a realistic same-week path from sign-up to live payments. Missing for 10: documented self-serve sign-up flow, approval/underwriting process and timeline, evidence of hardware delivery times, and independent corroboration of going live within a week.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
